note: This file is a declarative MMPose configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines training hyperparameters, model architecture, data pipelines, and evaluation settings for the Sapiens 0.6B human pose estimation model on the Goliath dataset.
review_config_sapiens_0_6b: review the sapiens 0.6b pose estimation config for goliath dataset training with 210 epochs
summarize_model_architecture: summarize the sapiens 0.6b vision transformer backbone with 1280 embed dim and 32 layers
summarize_train_pipeline: summarize the training data augmentation pipeline with albumentation coarse dropout and random bbox transform
review_optimizer_config: review the adamw optimizer with layer decay rate 0.85 and gradient clipping at norm 1.0
review_evaluator_config: review the goliath and coco wholebody combined evaluator for validation and test dataloaders
